description: Configure Table Rate Shipping for the 'Main Website' scope. Go to Stores > Configuration > Sales > Delivery Methods > Table Rates. You MUST switch the configuration scope to 'Main Website' (top-left switcher) to access the Import feature. Set Enabled to 'Yes', Title to 'Heavy Goods Shipping', and Condition to 'Weight vs. Destination'. Create and import a CSV file to set these specific rates for the USA (Country: US, Region: *, Zip: *): Weight 0 lbs = $15.00, Weight 10 lbs = $25.00. Save the configuration.
